# RC48 — Action-layer LSP log and restart

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc c l` / `code.lsp-log` / `Language Server Log`.
- Added `Esc c R` / `code.lsp-restart` / `Restart Language Server`.
- These actions expose the existing bounded read-only LSP log and restart flow through the portable no-timeout action layer, avoiding command-line entry on iPad/Blink.
- Restart keeps the existing semantics: stop the current client, clear synchronized documents, diagnostics, request state, workspace-symbol state, and retry the configured active-file server.
- Updated the CODE action-layer hint to show `l/R LSP`.
- Updated user-facing retry guidance to mention `Esc c R` alongside `:lsp-restart`.
- The README namespace table and iPad QA matrix now cover both action-layer and command-line routes.
